record.title: StepFun announces a 600B/27B-active MoE preview aimed at agentic work
record.summary: StepFun announced Step 5 Preview on September 20 as a flagship model for agentic work. In its Chinese-language announcement, the company reports a sparse MoE design with 600B total parameters and 27B active per token, a 1M-token context window, and native text and vision input. StepFun’s platform lists the model as an offering. The architecture and intended uses are company-reported; this review did not inspect a model card, weights or matched independent evaluation, and does not validate performance or cost claims.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: StepFun announced Step 5 Preview on 2026-09-20 as a flagship model for real-world agentic tasks, software engineering, professional knowledge work and finance.

claims.label: CLAIMED
claims.text: StepFun describes Step 5 Preview as a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 600 billion total parameters, 27 billion active per token, a one-million-token context window, and native text and vision input.

claims.label: DEMONSTRATED
claims.text: StepFun’s official platform lists Step 5 Preview among its available model offerings; the inspected sources do not establish the model’s benchmark performance or open-weight availability.

evidence_gaps.description: No independent matched evaluation establishes capability or cost relative to comparable models.
The promised open-weight status and exact release artifact were not verified.

brief.importance_rationale: If the announced design and intended agentic performance are borne out, a 600B model with only 27B active per token and 1M context could materially alter frontier-model choices for long-running tasks and deployment economics. The score reflects that potential consequence, not confidence: the technical specifications are vendor-reported and independent performance evidence is absent.
limitations: No model weights, independent model card audit or reproducible benchmark package was inspected.
The “24-hour autonomous optimization” language in intake is not in the reviewed source and is not part of this record.

brief.title: StepFun announces a 600B/27B-active MoE preview aimed at agentic work
brief.why_it_matters: The release is a new large-capacity Chinese model offering with a much smaller stated active-parameter count and a very long context window, aimed at agentic workloads. If the specifications and later performance measurements hold, it could affect model-choice and inference-cost comparisons; the current public record establishes the launch and company-reported design only.
